summary: Extending A2 and A8 from 30,720 to 250,880 transitions produced no held-out progress advantage at any extended checkpoint. A8 retained material rich-observation influence, and all controller/training health checks passed, but both continued policies stayed in Zone 1 while frozen A2 remained the only arm to reach Floor 2 on the common seeds. Retain A2 and investigate the stochastic-policy evaluation mismatch and shared reward/optimization objective before further architecture scaling.
